method: python3 play.py --check-codex --model MODEL --timeout 60; elapsed measured with /usr/bin/time -p
scope: One real Codex CLI decision per model, using the signed-in account and the game's role prompt and structured output schema.
limitations: Connection and legal-action smoke tests, not a controlled speed benchmark. Each run uses a newly dealt two-player hand. Spark and Luna checks ran concurrently. Elapsed time includes CLI startup and strategy analysis.
